name: run the helper and press Enter as a real terminal does
the value landed exactly, with no CR and mode 600
cmd: SZ=`wc -c < /root/.config/temur/key`; V=`cat /root/.config/temur/key`; echo size=$SZ; ls -l /root/.config/temur/key; [ "$V" = "NOT-A-REAL-KEY-0123456789" ] && [ "$SZ" = 25 ] && echo CR-PROOF-OK

name: no stray CR byte in the file
cmd: od -c /root/.config/temur/key | head -3; od -c /root/.config/temur/key | grep -c '\\r' ; echo checked
